Question:
For each match, considering every innings, please combine runs from both batsman scored and extra runs for each over, then identify the single over with the highest total runs, retrieve the bowler for that over from the ball by ball table, and calculate the average of these highest over totals across all matches, ensuring that all runs and bowler details are accurately reflected.

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bbs.match_id,
        bbs.over_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(bbs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bbs.match_id = er.match_id 
        AND bbs.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND bbs.ball_id = er.ball_id 
    GROUP BY bbs.match_id, bbs.over_id
),
first_ball_bowler AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, bowler
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE ball_id = 1
),
over_runs_with_bowler AS (
    SELECT 
        or_data.match_id,
        or_data.over_id,
        or_data.total_runs,
        fb.bowler
    FROM over_runs or_data
    JOIN first_ball_bowler fb ON or_data.match_id = fb.match_id AND or_data.over_id = fb.over_id
),
max_over_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, over_id) as rn,
        match_id,
        total_runs,
        bowler
    FROM over_runs_with_bowler
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_matches,
    AVG(total_runs) as average_highest_over_runs,
    MIN(total_runs) as min_highest_over,
    MAX(total_runs) as max_highest_over
FROM (
    SELECT match_id, total_runs
    FROM max_over_per_match
    WHERE rn = 1
)

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        b.over_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) AS over_total_runs
    FROM match m
    INNER JOIN ball_by_ball b ON m.match_id = b.match_id
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON m.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON m.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
    WHERE m.match_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.match_id, b.over_id
),
match_max_over AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        MAX(over_total_runs) AS highest_over_total
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(highest_over_total) AS avg_highest_over_total,
    COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM match_max_over;
